name: How much does kitchen backsplash tile installation cost around Denver?

mainEntity.name: How much does kitchen backsplash tile installation cost around Denver?

acceptedAnswer.text: Costs vary based on square footage, tile type, pattern complexity, and whether old tile must be removed. Denver-area pricing commonly ranges from a few hundred dollars for small repairs to several thousand dollars for full or custom installations.
acceptedAnswer.description: Pricing depends on size, materials, and prep work. Small repairs can be a few hundred dollars, while full or custom backsplash projects can run into the thousands.
